comparison.objective: Hold an enabling lever while moving a part through a cell, versus adjust and test an isolated shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained bimanual hold-to-run coordination and transport versus tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, relocking, and guarded control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Lever continuously held during motion, part released in output, then lever released versus de-energized adjustment followed by two safe physical cycles and drift testing.
comparison.reason: The common safety sequencing does not amount to the same tested ability. No spec versions are present; the body lacks motion-path and lever-state timing tolerances.
